title: SequenceEqual — LINQ Equality Operator
description: Learn to compare sequences for equality using the SequenceEqual operator.

data.text: The `SequenceEqual` method checks whether two sequences are equal by comparing the number of elements, the value of each element, and the order of elements.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: SequenceEqual compares element count, values, and order
For complex types: compares references by default
Use IEqualityComparer<T> for value comparison of complex types
